entities.name: Mongol Invasions
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Series of devastating conquests (1206–1294) by the Mongol Empire across Eurasia, destroying empires, cities, and killing millions. Paradoxically, the resulting Pax Mongolica enabled unprecedented Eurasian trade and cultural exchange.
